title: Unit Event — Deep Dark for Light — Episode4 The Gulf Between Us

meta.Event Outline: On the last day of the workshop, Wonderlands×Showtime learn about the upcoming ArcLand Show Contest, and they decide to compete. Faced with the challenging role of a prince beset by despair, Tsukasa becomes keenly aware of the gap between himself and Asahi.

rows.Line: ArcLand - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “No more...”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Thank you, Harte... But this is the end. There's nothing left for me.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What...is this?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His gaze, his movements... Everything about him is “empty”.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's almost as if a dark, enveloping void has opened up behind him.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't look away...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Blesse! Come on, Blesse!
This isn't like you!”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “None of this matters.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
“No matter what I do, humanity will still hate.
Countries will still wage war.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “No matter how much we wrack our brains, no matter what we try to accomplish... Nothing ever changes.”

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “It's all meaningless.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Blesse!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's achieved this level of performance after only one read-through...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (To grasp the core of the character as I envisioned him, and express him almost perfectly, in such a short time... As uncanny as ever.)

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh... Sorry, I went on pretty long.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: There's a lot of substance to this role. I got a bit carried away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's an honor to hear you say so, Asahi.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Oh, right! So, about how I would play the role...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: “Despair” is one of the themes of this show. So I think the expression of that despair is the key to the whole thing.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I might go so far as to say that how genuinely you portray the prince's despair in the end will make or break the show as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: The deeper the prince's despair, the brighter the princess will shine as she continues striving to hold onto hope.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So you think so, too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did think that was the case... But I haven't captured it fully yet.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I understand. This is a pretty difficult thing, after all.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Figuring out how to show it is one thing... But people don't often experience emotions strong enough to be called “despair”, either.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: You might want to try to imagine what would drive you to that kind of deepest despair.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What would drive me to despair...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yeah. If you can grasp the despair inside you, it might make it easier to imagine the prince's despair, too.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I don't think it'll be a pleasant experience, though.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No... Thank you very much. I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: ArcLand Cast Member A
rows.Line: Hey, Asahi! We're starting back up!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
Huh?! Already?!
I didn't get to eat my lunch...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to take up your entire break...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Don't worry, I can scarf it down! I had a lot of fun with this.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: If there's anything else you think I can do, just ask. I'll be happy to help!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I will!
se_run_men_005_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (All my training and growth I've undergone only make it easier to see.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even after all this time...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There is a yawning gap between myself and Asahi.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Maybe it's his unceasing hard work, or maybe it's inborn talent... Or perhaps it's both.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Whatever the cause...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (There is a huge gulf between us.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Between his ability...and mine.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Can I bridge it?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Can I get to where he is...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not “can I”. I will.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm well aware of my own inadequacy. I know that my path forward will not be an easy one.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even so, I remain resolved to walk it.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And... I will not falter on my way.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...?
